title: Extended pharmacological miosis is superfluous after glaucoma angle surgery: A retrospective study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license> and ali:license_ref); associated data CC0

indication: phakic eyes with glaucoma (mostly POAG; also chronic angle-closure, exfoliation and other glaucomas; Table 1) without prior incisional or angle surgery
design: retrospective comparative study of all Trabectome surgeries 2012-2017 at one institute; not randomized or matched

groups.description: Trabectome ab interno trabeculectomy (about 160 degrees), alone or with same-session phacoemulsification (79% of all eyes combined), without postoperative pilocarpine (P-)
Trabectome ab interno trabeculectomy, alone or with same-session phacoemulsification, with pilocarpine 1% four times daily for one month then three times daily for a second month (P+)

exclusions.reason: same baselines as Table 3 (the 'All' column would duplicate both groups)

exclusions.what: Figure 2 B/C subgroup IOP (Trabectome alone vs with phacoemulsification)
Figure 1 Kaplan-Meier survival and Table 2 hazard ratios
exclusions.reason: Kaplan-Meier estimates and model hazard ratios are not admissible

exclusions.what: peer-review report sub-articles in the XML

notes: Tonometer is not stated in the article; method unstated.
Preoperative IOP on glaucoma medication (baseline medications tabulated in Tables 1 and 4); all glaucoma medications were stopped after surgery and resumed if IOP was above target.
Medication: mean number of glaucoma medications at baseline and months 1/3/6/12 is tabulated in Table 4; not extracted.

Role ambiguity: the Introduction states that most surgeons give pilocarpine for two months after angle surgery, and the authors later stopped using it; neither arm is declared experimental and pilocarpine is not investigational, so both groups are role control (two postoperative-care variants) with the regimen in the group description.
Both groups mix Trabectome alone and Trabectome combined with phacoemulsification; the tables do not separate them.

series.notes: mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported (eyes with less than 3 months of follow-up were excluded, later attrition not stated)
